title: Packed vector loads for recurrent state: production performance and correctness

sourceRevision.harness: The PR32 recurrence check harness was already present in the baseline.

capabilityBoundary.specialization: Subgroup-enabled specialization reads Q/K projection data as vec4<f32> packed loads and uses the existing scalar arithmetic and subgroup reductions.
capabilityBoundary.fallback: SUBGROUPS=0 retains the prior scalar storage binding and shared fallback.

hardware.scope: Local served builds on one host; profile GPU time is not per-request or wall latency.

chromeProductionSuite.metric: Geometric mean of per-case median summed GPU kernel milliseconds over three input sizes; five measured requests after two warmups per size.
chromeProductionSuite.aggregateMethod: Both complete runs per version are combined geometrically; four-family value is the geometric mean of the four family metrics.

actualRecurrenceProfile.metric: For each input size, take the median of five requests’ gpu.recur values; combine both run medians geometrically. The model summary is the geometric mean across three input sizes.

fullSuite.interpretation: One paired cross-browser check. Timing difference is control variation, not an attributed packed-load gain.
